body:
T3:00 took 1.5-2g ground syrian rue powder.  Took a few sips of tea.
T3:40 drank my first cup tea. Not bad tasting. Feel body kind of buzzing from MAOI. I notice rue even makes smoking weed feel better/last longer. I feel pretty good.
T4:20 drank second cup. Starting to feel very euphoric. Reminds me of ecstasy but I see CEV. I believe ayahuasca allows you to conceive your imagination with brighter imagery. Whatever youve seen through your visual input can be played back through your visual cortex. Like our brain records everything we see. And DMT is somewhat like a time machine.
T5:00 drank another cup. Im surprised I have no open eye visuals. I was expecting something rather different from the experience. Id say at low dose as Ive prepared my tea 2 cups should be the max with max 3g rue for an experience.
T9:00 I took about 2-2.5g more syrian rue and down about 3 more coffee mugs of it. Id been smoking weed through the experience at least 4-5times it helps tremendously with nausea.
T9:30-10:00 what have I done. Im starting to vomit everywhere. I feel like the exorcist movie. Im lying on the floor by the toilet. I feel like Im dying tonight. My thoughts are erased every 5-10 seconds. I feel totally confused & disoriented. I try to smoke one more time then I throw up again. I start saying fuck drugs. I totally believe Im dying tonight... I end up calling 911 Im freaking out so bad like 4 er & 3 sheriffs show up. I cant even communicate cuz my brain keeps being erased & I feel so tired that comes in waves. They strap me down in the ambulance cuz they think Im crazy. Every poke with the needle they do hurts so bad it feels like my arm is going to explode. Id figured hypertensive crisis. I could feel so much pain. The hospital gave me benadryl & I slept through.
I thought I should have know to have a backup in case the experience went wrong. Next few days after I had severe stomach pains & anxiety. I thought I was going to die... Over all I knew I shouldnt of had the last 3-4 cups I had a bad feeling. I would say if Id stuck to only 2 cups Id had a good time... I dont know how I forgot the extreme near death experiences reported. After all the months of research Id done... I think I just wanted to be more happy but I should have know my limit.
After all the months of research Id done... I think I just wanted to be more happy but I should have know my limit.
I will probably never fuck with that shit again. I hate the way I feel after this experience. Never again. Fuck MAOI it always fucks my stomach up bad. In retrospect Id probably of been better to boil even more water out to make 1 dose equal to just ½ -1 cup so I consume less water with the drug. I think is what makes it somewhat so nauseating.  Overall I like mushrooms better. I think the CEVs are way brighter & more intense plus I get OEVs and nearly same chemical structure.
[Reported Dose: "15g chacruna - psychotria viridis 8g chacruna - psychotria viridis about 6cups outta 8 lil more than half gallon total reduced tea"]
